name: Racial Pride of Arms
body:
You consider weapons not designed for use by your race as an indignity.

Prerequisite: Weapon familiarity racial trait

Effect: -4 on all attack rolls made when using a weapon not specified by your weapon familiarity racial trait. This includes unarmed and touch attacks (including ranged touch) and also natural weapons.
